question: Can a bounded own-child decoder recover cell positions and owners for the exact old image and detect independent native mutations?
decision_rule: FIXTURE_PASS requires exact image/executable/mapped executable DSO pins, two eight-cell containers at derived stride, bounded position and 256-bit owner vector reads matching specified native oracle for honest, position-mutant and owner-mutant cases, and verified cleanup of each captured child. Any missing data, drift, mismatch, STOP, deadline or cleanup failure is INVALID. No server, head, batch, task, stream or historical verdict.
stop_rule: Stop on three cases and cleanup, or on mismatch, image or mapping drift, STOP, signal or 60-second local or grant deadline; no retries.
notes: Fresh successor; each smoke or grant builds its own publisher; old binary and outputs excluded.
